facts.fact: The Ministry of Information and Communication Technology published a revised 59-page draft Data Protection Bill for comment, dated 2022 (month March taken from the publisher's filename, not the text), with the gazette notice number left blank.
The revised draft's long title provides for establishing a Data Protection Supervisory Authority and its powers, duties and functions; this is a draft and no body is stated as constituted.
